title: The Annals of Karsus
summary: Read to gain the unique Scroll of Dethrone and advance Gale’s quest.

fields.Vault route: Open Silverhand, Abjuration and Silver in that order. Pull the lever, return to the puzzle entrance and enter Karsus. Knock can also open the Karsus door.
fields.Read: Produces a Scroll of Dethrone and advances The Wizard of Waterdeep. Dethrone targets one creature at 100 ft for 10d6 + 20 Necrotic, Constitution save for half. A Wizard can transcribe it and cast the learned level 5 spell once per Long Rest. Free casting effects do not bypass this cooldown.
fields.Acquisition: Karsus section of the Sorcerous Vault, X 319, Y 1000.
fields.Base value: 2000 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
